title: 🔆🔅In response to Donald Trump's claim that negotiations would begin today, the Iranian Foreign Ministry Spokesperson stated that Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi is currently traveling for the Arbaeen pilgrimage (Iraq) today, and that the rest of the negotiating team are also in Iran.
text:
🔆🔅In response to Donald Trump's claim that negotiations would begin today, the Iranian Foreign Ministry Spokesperson stated that Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi is currently traveling for the Arbaeen pilgrimage (Iraq) today, and that the rest of the negotiating team are also in Iran."

"The Spokesperson further emphasized that Iran currently has no intention of hosting any delegation, nor will it be a guest of any other party."

"—making it clear that no talks are scheduled to take place today.
